headline: Analysis of student achievement data and a self-evaluation process using the CABE evaluation instrument.
summary: The meeting covers a review of student achievement data. It also includes a discussion and an approval vote on the process for an initial self-evaluation using a CABE evaluation instrument.
items: Discussion of the process for completing an initial self-evaluation of the Board of Education using the CABE evaluation instrument
Approval of the process for completing an initial self-evaluation of the Board of Education using the CABE evaluation instrument
plain_text:
ANNOUNCEMENT OF ZOOM GOALS AND EVALUATIONS COMMITTEE  
MEETING AGENDA 
 
When: October 19, 2026 6:00 PM  
Location- Zoom 
 
To join the meeting virtually, please click the link below to join the webinar: 
https://hamden.zoom.us/j/87131264789?pwd=shjwV45bJ1Kbb88DGV9azyyAiAuLoN.1  
Passcode:802635 
 
Telephone: +1 305 224 1968, +1 309 205 3325, +1 312 626 6799, +1 646 558 8656, +1 646 931 3860 
 
Note: Any member of the public may request, in writing, a physical location and “any electronic equipment necessary” to attend the 
meeting in real-time. Said request shall be made to tdonnarummo@hamden.org not less than twenty-four (24) hours prior to the 
meeting. 
 
For those who wish to make Public Comments: Time will be allotted for public comments at the beginning of the 
meeting. We ask that public comments be limited to no more than 1 minute in length. You may also submit your 
comment in writing. Public comments should be sent to PublicInput@hamden.org, with the message's subject 
stating the meeting's name and date (for example, “May 12 Operations Committee Meeting”). Public comments 
will be accepted up to 1pm the day of the meeting. Please note the following: 
The name and Hamden address of the person submitting public comment must be included in the 
message. 
Remarks should be brief and concise, with a maximum length of three minutes (about 450 characters). 
Comments should start with a 2-3 sentence summary. The summary will be read instead of the entire message 
if there is a large number of comments and reading each of them in their entirety would extend beyond the time 
allotted for public comment. 
 
1. Call to order and roll call 
2. Public Comments on Agenda Items 
3. Additions to the Agenda 
4. Information Item 
a. Analysis of student achievement data 
b. Discussion of the process for completing an initial self-evaluation of the Board of Education using 
the evaluation instrument provided by CABE. 
 
5. Action Item 
a. Approval of the process for completing an initial self-evaluation of the Board of Education using 
the evaluation instrument provided by CABE. 
 
6. Adjournment
